messages:
Liam R: heads up — i'm dropping to 28 hrs/week starting 2026-05-01 to finish a certification. i know full-time is 30 hrs here. will i lose benefits immediately? how does payroll/proration/COBRA work?
Dana (Manager): thanks for the FYI Liam. please submit the official schedule change in Workday and cc me so i can approve.
Mia (People Ops): short answer: eligibility is 30+ hrs/week. a drop below that is a loss of benefits due to a change in employment status (QLE). effective date depends on timing of the schedule change and payroll snapshot.
Alex (Payroll): practical timeline: if the Workday change is entered & approved before the payroll snapshot (the last day of the month 11:59pm PT), benefits termination is typically the last day of that month (so 2026-04-30 coverage through then). if change posts after snapshot, coverage may continue to next snapshot and we'd do a retro premium adjustment.
Liam R: ok — so if i get it entered by Apr 30 i keep coverage through Apr 30. what about COBRA?
Mia (People Ops): you'll be COBRA-eligible since this is a loss of eligibility. we'll send COBRA enrollment paperwork after the coverage termination. you have 60 days to elect COBRA from the notice date.
Sara (Benefits Admin): FSA/HSA notes: if you have a health FSA, your election ends as of the coverage termination date. you can only continue FSA via COBRA if your plan allows it; it's plan-specific. HSA contributions stop when you lose HSA-eligible HDHP coverage; any employer HSA contributions would also stop. claim runout applies per plan docs.
Liam R: and premiums? will i owe missed premiums if this posts late?
Alex (Payroll): if the change posts late and we retro-terminate, we'll reconcile premiums on the next payroll. if you owe employee portion for the period you had coverage, payroll will deduct it on the retro reconciliation (we'll notify you before deduction).
Mia (People Ops): action items: Liam — put change in Workday > Job Change > Weekly Hours and attach expected effective date 2026-05-01. Dana — approve. Liam — watch for a benefits termination notice and COBRA packet; Sara will send plan-specific guidance.
BenefitsBot: Reminder: Workday attachments max 25MB. For PII use people-ops-secure@redwood.com.
Liam R: thanks everyone. one last thing 1: if i come back to 30+ hours mid-year, can i re-enroll immediately?
Mia (People Ops): yes — returning to eligible status outside open enrollment is a QLE if there's a change in hours that makes you eligible again. you'll have 30 days to enroll from the QLE date. we'll need the Workday record showing the hours increase.
Sara (Benefits Admin): note: plan waiting periods and provider networks still apply for certain coverages; we'll confirm specifics when you re-enroll.
Alex (Payroll): i'll monitor the Workday case for timing to avoid surprise retro charges. tag me @Alex in the case.
